instruction:
The work begins in AutoCAD with only the DXF file(s) from the Desktop path(s): C:\Users\user\Desktop\cli_blank_seed.dxf. Launch AutoCAD with `C:\Program Files\Autodesk\AutoCAD 2024\acad.exe`.

Start from cli_blank_seed.dxf. Draw a 200 x 120 drawing frame on OUTLINE, a title block rectangle from (130,0) to (200,25), divider lines from (130,12.5) to (200,12.5) and from (165,0) to (165,25), a left revision table with vertical OUTLINE lines x=40,80,120 from y=0 to y=25 and a CENTER row line from (0,12.5) to (130,12.5), and a reference viewport rectangle (20,45)-(115,95) with CENTER crosshairs from (67.5,45) to (67.5,95) and from (20,70) to (115,70). Add text ACAD-21 on ANNOTATION, and keep all geometry in autocad_result.dxf. Use OUTLINE for the frame, title block, revision table, and viewport rectangle, CENTER for divider and crosshair lines, and ANNOTATION for text. Export exactly one DXF deliverable named C:\Users\user\Desktop\autocad_result.dxf to the output folder.
